title: Earned Share of a FloodGuard Limit Increase by Attach Date
content:
The earned share of a limit increase on a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy is chosen by how far into the term the increase attaches:

- when the increase attaches at least 90 days after the term's effective date, the share is the whole calendar months from the attach date to the expiration date divided by twelve;
- when it attaches no more than 30 days after the term's effective date, the full annual premium change is charged;
- in every other case the share is the calendar days from the attach date to the expiration date divided by the calendar days in the term.

**Measuring "how far into the term".** The count is the calendar days from the term's effective date to the date the increase attaches, both taken from the policy and its limit-increase entry. The first line is tested first: an increase at 90 days or more takes the month share; an increase at 30 days or fewer takes the full change; 31 to 89 days takes the day share.

| Calendar days from the term's effective date to the attach date | Earned share |
|---|---|
| 0 to 30 | the full annual premium change (a share of one) |
| 31 to 89 | calendar days from the attach date to the expiration date, divided by the calendar days in the term |
| 90 or more | whole calendar months from the attach date to the expiration date, divided by twelve |

**Boundary cases on a hypothetical term** from 2025-01-01 to 2026-01-01 (365 calendar days):

| Attach date | Days into the term | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-01-31 | 30 | full (one) |
| 2025-02-01 | 31 | 334 divided by 365 |
| 2025-03-31 | 89 | 276 divided by 365 |
| 2025-04-01 | 90 | 9 whole months divided by twelve |

At 90 days only whole calendar months count toward the share: from 2025-04-01 to 2026-01-01 there are 9 whole months, so the share is nine twelfths. An increase attaching on 2025-04-15 (104 days in) has 8 whole months to 2026-01-01 (the part-month from 2025-12-15 does not count), giving eight twelfths.
